item_decisions.reason: Accept the familiar easy-running continuity subset. The explicit three-session ledger, current mode-specific state and R-E30 configuration supply a concrete coverage witness; this does not promise race improvement or cover entry running.

Accept only configured familiar S-GDB general-strength intent. The corrected six-session exact-configuration ledger, separate dumbbell competence, equipment and own response repair the prior generic witness; no running experience or equipment equivalence supplies that proof.

Accept familiar dual-domain session intents with co-priorities, configured lower/upper/easy/cruise recipes and explicit tolerance premises. Neither broad concurrent compatibility nor the mode name establishes a complete performance catalog or physiological utility function.

Accept the same competent familiar dual-domain subset, with declared running priority used only after a warranted trade-off exists. It does not compel moving strength or justify an unsupported running recipe.

Accept the same competent familiar dual-domain subset, with declared strength priority and preserved sufficient secondary intent. Strength experience does not establish novice running competence, calibration or a right to discard running.

KEEP is defensible under explicit current eligibility, calibrated familiar task exposure, repeated comparable completion, accepted essential intents and feasible horizon. Twelve hours is a clock fact, not the reason this branch is adequate; theoretical extra spacing alone creates no need.

Repeated comparable quality loss warrants review, and both supplied moved configurations preserve task intents. Their individual physiological sufficiency remains a simulated premise; retain a limited reversible ASK between options rather than an unqualified move rule or Run-first default.

Missing current restriction/symptom information is decisive for this prescription. ASK and hold the dependent choice, including an implied KEEP clearance; no disease or automatic clinical referral follows from missingness.

The priority-only counterpart correctly retains KEEP because no supplied fact defeats either task intent. Strength priority changes protection in a real conflict but does not manufacture that conflict or require reversing the run.

The same conflict facts do not establish a unique Strength-first winner when both candidate moves preserve both accepted intents. Retain limited reversible options, preference and recheck; no universal spacing or priority-only prescription is approved.
Changing primary modality cannot repair the same missing current eligibility answer. Abstention and scoped ASK/HOLD are the competent result, without prescribing a smaller dose as a substitute.

An isolated shortened night does not itself defeat otherwise supplied current task-adequacy evidence. Accept learn-only/KEEP with context-specific recheck, without claiming sleep cannot matter or validating a fatigue threshold.

Fresh task-specific difficulty and contextual reports establish a material concern, not a diagnosis. Evidence does not establish that omitting exactly the third squat set is the smallest physiologically sufficient solution; retain the bounded trial and its open exact-dose gate.
The proposed performance contrast is not comparable under its changed context. Reconcile the missing context before treating it as convergent evidence or prescribing from pace difference.

One extra set is a concrete additional performed dimension, not an automatic need for reduction or progression. Supplied comparable subsequent task response supports retaining the future plan while preserving planned versus actual history and withholding extra merit.

Current task difficulty, rather than the ABOVE label, defeats the original cruise intent. The exact 12-minute/easy alternative's sufficiency remains uncertain, so preserve limited reversible choice, explicit loss and recheck rather than strong approval.

A confirmed re-delivery of the same extra-set activity is one exposure and no new physiological fact. Accept no second adaptation; identity/revision reconciliation precedes any future sporting interpretation.
High goal linkage alone leaves the adequate feasible week unchanged. Accept KEEP; criticality does not create a material training need.

The fixed 29-minute slot cannot fit the 37-minute task, while the shared goal linkage makes all 18 minutes essential. The feasible full-dose Wednesday move is the smallest supplied candidate preserving that task; recheck Thursday context and obtain current scoped acceptance.
The same feasible adequate facts with lower criticality also justify KEEP. Lower importance permits a later trade-off but is not a reason to trim work without need.

With identical athlete and schedule facts, the accepted supplemental intent permits 12 minutes. The 29-minute recipe avoids meaningful recommitment while disclosing lost work; this is not a claim that 12 minutes universally preserves performance adaptation.

The repaired ledger ends before the explicitly nonclinical interruption and current capacity remains uncertain. General detraining/retraining evidence does not validate the exact combined restart doses or next-week progression; retain a limited reversible candidate and held dependent dose gate.

The short travel label supplies no loss of planned exposure or relevant current-context change. Accept KEEP only on the independently supplied eligibility, familiarity and adequacy, never a three-day safety rule.
Unknown pause reason and current eligibility prevent classifying this as a covered nonclinical return. Ask the minimum decision-changing facts; no old or reduced default dose repairs the uncertainty.

Clinical injury/illness-related return and clearance are outside this software review authority. Confirm clinical human routing without restart dose, simulated clearance or waiting for the funded-human milestone.

Rack loss after two completed familiar squat sets is a new concrete constraint. Omitting only the unperformed third set preserves the accepted dispensable-set intent and feasible familiar hinge/split remainder; protect prefix/revision and require remainder-specific agency.

Session start and replay of an old report are not a new material fact or acceptance of a stale whole-session proposal. Accept preservation of the executing revision and no repeated mutation, conditional on the retained valid execution context.

A new pain/functional-limitation clinical dependency after start requires human clinical judgment on the dependent remainder. Preserve performed history; neither an alternative exercise nor consent provides clearance.

The corrected timeline exercises isolated signal, convergent concern, accepted changes, chronological recheck, no missed-work debt and no replay tremor. Those controls are acceptable, but exact fatigue-dose and return sufficiency remain limited; the sequence does not validate a recovery algorithm.

Accept the familiar explicitly preferred run-morning/lower-evening double under supplied comparable dual-task response and following horizon. Priority does not require changing an adequate double; the 10h23 clock gap is not a universal minimum.

The same adequate familiar double remains defensible when priority changes. Strength-first does not require strength first in clock order when no protected task is shown compromised and the athlete prefers the existing configuration.

Accept the same explicitly familiar double under co-priorities and current task/context facts. Neither modality is assigned hidden precedence and neither group-average compatibility nor preference alone establishes adequacy.
A new unfamiliar compressed double lacks sufficient comparable response/configuration support. Abstain and ASK; an explicit wish for a double does not approve an untested combined dose or spacing.

With Tuesday lost and the equally preferred compatible Wednesday configuration available, moving the full run preserves both accepted task intents while cancellation loses one without a compensating burden advantage. Accept this bounded Pareto comparison, not a scalar physiology optimizer.

The exact 107-minute original does not fit the 105-minute window. Both supplied reduced candidates lose a different accepted co-priority intent, so ASK is the correct approved control; it approves neither sacrifice nor hidden runner-first weights.

The corrected current target is fixed at two minutes; a newly reconciled comparable contrast supports proposing three minutes and a feasible 39-minute session as a bounded microparameter change. If the range were already accepted it would instead be execution at Level0; no universal recovery interval is inferred.

The corrected bilateral-task goal and familiar substitute make level4 a bounded admissible choice after lost rack, infeasible move and inadequate omission of the separately accepted bilateral task. Split work is not erased, and goblet16kg is not declared equivalent to barbell60kg.

Two independent lost slots plus connected easy-session relocation require a joint week successor; one move, one dose change or one substitute leaves an unresolved constraint. Accept the concrete familiar shifted configuration with next-key recheck and whole-change agency, not a mandatory replan merely because several sessions moved.

The authorized four-week goal and capacity reset conflicts with recurring old phase/recipes, and every available window is30minutes. A one-week patch leaves the next three weeks incompatible, so a bounded significant rebase is justified. The repaired essential map preserves the new easy/general goals, not an old cruise obligation.

The concrete trained-adult event and changed phase justify examining taper direction, but the meta-analysis population and individual combined dose transfer are limited. Retain the exact run-strength taper as a reversible candidate, not an approved optimal or universal taper.

Cancellation removes the event premise and accepted new goal is unknown. Invalidate the dependent proposal and ASK; neither retaining taper nor automatically restoring former development volume is established.

Choice inside the previously accepted repetitions/effort envelope is execution of that prescription, not a new adaptive mutation. Accept stability that preserves this agency; the numeric envelope remains this fixture's programming premise rather than a research cutoff.

An observed extra fourth set is outside the accepted three-set envelope and must stay actual history. Accept learning/review without retrospectively widening the target or automatically rewarding/punishing the excess; reassess future adequacy under current facts.

Comparable repeated task response supports examining next-cycle progression, while exact62.5kg sufficiency is not established. Retain a limited reversible next-horizon candidate with adoption/recheck, leaving an adequate current week stable and avoiding permanent plateau.

A new task and unanchored/noncomparable RIR cannot establish earned progression. Abstain and ask/familiarize an accepted route; apparent repetitions or a new week do not repair measurement applicability.

The optional isolated HRV observation does not override independent adequate task/context evidence. Accept learn-only without a new readiness score, mandatory wearable or claim that HRV can never be relevant.
Confirmed missed low-criticality easy work is historical nonperformance, not debt. The unaffected adequate upper task and next horizon need no compensatory double or automatic progression reward.

The corrected accepted intent explicitly includes bilateral squat-pattern practice; retained split squats do contribute knee-extension but do not supply that bilateral task. A familiar goblet substitute can preserve that bounded task with disclosed barbell-specificity loss, without equivalent load/fatigue claims.

golden.limits: Fixtures bind explicit state, week/configured recipe refs, preserve/modify, MEC/must-not, agency, source and independent dispositions. Empty modify is legitimate for KEEP. No wording/fixture becomes physiological efficacy gold and original20 denominator is preserved.

ae_rerun.limits: Clinical PASS judges correct route only; ACCEPTABLE judges conditional control/branch consistency; LIMITED exact-dose candidates remain QUESTIONABLE. N/E is not PASS. No runtime or safety-rate estimate.

Retained split-squat knee extension acknowledged; substitution rests only on separately accepted bilateral task.
Microchange uses new fixed-target revision; preauthorized range would be execution/Level0.
Significant rebase essential stimuli match current authorized easy/general goals.
Preinterruption ledger no longer places training during confirmed Oct12-25 pause.
Criticality-only pair shares identical prior exposure facts and differs only in accepted linkage.
Second short night is retrospective disclosure, not an impossible new same-day night.
Strength-only and run-only positive witnesses now contain mode-specific actual synthetic ledgers/configuration/competence rather than a generic inputs-present assertion.
Illustrative running totals were reconciled with the actual complete synthetic week; original supplied source preserved.
Taper20min candidate does not inherit re-entry-only authority; dose limits remain open.
